name: Gotsutotsukotsu
source: King of the southern barbarian kingdom of Wugegoku. She is a tall brown amazoness clad in scales. She boasts of her "Fujikou" armor, which is impervious to both swords and bows. She is ferocious and belligerent. She is a headstrong, aggressive person, but loves sex.
